title: A page item found false closes itself the same turn, with a reply naming the record that shows it false
why: Owner 14:36 CST Nov 18 on item 956: it should have been closed automatically once found false, and should never have been posted. Triage 11 found it false at 11:56 CST and left it open until the owner answered 'none of these'.
note: Two halves. (1) Never posted: draft PR 3666 (step guard-question-checks-past-rulings) widens the past-ruling check to owner-ruling sentences. (2) Closed when found false: a rule for the page writer, and ideally a check, that an item whose premise a session has found false is closed in the same turn with a reply naming the record. Prior-work search first. Mistake it stops: an owner is asked a question whose own record shows it moot. Not built: the check for (2).
